_comment: Instant booking for the paid consultation. Each option is a live Stripe payment link in the SIA "Stonks" account; Stripe Tax adds 21% VAT on top of the shown price. THIS FILE IS THE ONLY PLACE THE CONSULTATION PRICES LIVE - the consultation page renders them from here, so changing a price here changes every mention on that page. Prose on other pages (tiktok-kursi, blog posts) is static and must be updated by hand; grep for the old number. To finish the one-click flow, set each link's After payment behaviour in Stripe to redirect to `calendarUrl`; until that URL is set the copy promises a follow-up instead of an instant calendar, so nothing on the page is untrue.
